fieldValues.title: How do we test that a repository reads well?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (5. How we know a repository reads well), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. A person who did not write it reads it front to back (Wave 5's criterion).
- B. A cold agent explains it and finds a named record (the zero-context test).
- C. A reachability report: everything is reachable from the root (srs-rust#1490).
- D. All three, at different moments.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which test catches the failures we have seen: the data dump, the empty front door, scrambled order.
fieldValues.next_action: Run the cold-agent test and the reachability count on Research and LiveWyer and compare with a human read.
